At this stage, young men, although they do not yet have a voice or vote in the tribe, are still appreciated by women because they are the future and they await their potential.

entries.name: Woman
entries.content:
Women on the island can be between 100 and 200 cm tall  They do not age externally and keep their skin tight and smooth until their last days. They are usually classified into three categories.  Shorstack, Middle and Amazons.

Women are usually monogamous and rarely want to settle down with just one man. They can also choose whether to raise their children personally or raise them jointly with the tribe.

Characteristics

1) All adult women are fertile and usually have a good libido

2) Attracted to virility men

3) Repulsed by Eunuchs men

4) They do not age externally and maintain their youthful appearance until they die of old age.

6) They can be of different skin tones and ethnicity.

entries.name: Stallions
entries.content:
Stallions are former Betas who have been promoted either for their achievements, sexual prowess, or other exploits that have impressed or helped the tribe.

While Stallions still have to perform duties like other men, they enjoy certain privileges, such as the possibility of having a wife as long as the woman agrees, and the legitimate right to participate in orgies.
